purpose: Fresh paired PEMS07 H96 capacity screen for a full-coverage four-token MambaTS v3 graph.
research_question: Can a d_model=32 full-coverage four-token graph repair the H96 capacity gap while retaining a faster-than-TimeMixer prediction path?
selection_history: The graph is resource-selected only: patch_len=24, patch_stride=24, d_model=32, d_ff=64, d_state=8, d_conv=2, expand=1. Same-shape PEMS07 H96 forward is 0.626 ms versus TimeMixer 2.630 ms. Fresh seeds are 2161/2162/2163.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory H96 capacity screen. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result justifies a fresh four-PEMS confirmation, not a publication claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint, M feature geometry, and train-only normalization contract
freeze full-coverage p24/s24 d32 MambaTS v3 active/null graph and dimensions
verify same-shape d32 candidate and TimeMixer GPU forward measurements

phases.name: pems07_h96_mambatsv3_fullcover_p24_s24_d32_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact d32 full-coverage H96 graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems07_h96_mambatsv3_fullcover_p24_s24_d32_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact d32 full-coverage H96 graph with lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: candidate versus historical PEMS07 H96 MambaTS v3 reference
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Use same-shape PEMS07 H96 B32 preflights for d32 candidate and TimeMixer.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, all-PEMS, or general claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
If candidate mean is more than 2% worse than historical PEMS07 H96 MambaTS v3 reference, stop this route.
If active/null is not directionally reproducible, make no causal AutoCon accuracy claim.
Do not release test metrics from this probe.
